name: Commerce Tokens
project_description:
This module provides new commerce tokens.

 Tokens included 
 
 Commerce currency : Tokens related to commerce currency entity. 
 Current Commerce Store : Tokens related to the request's store. 
 Default Commerce Store : Tokens related to the default store. 
 Current Commerce Order : Tokens related to the request's order. 
 Current Commerce Product : Tokens related to the request's product. 
 Current Commerce Product Variation : Tokens related to the request's product variation.
